using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Tsavorite.core;
using Xunit;

namespace Tsavorite.Tests
{
    public class RecoveryTests
    {
        private class TestTsavoriteKV : TsavoriteKV<int, int, DummyStoreFunctions, DummyAllocator>
        {
            public ILogger Logger { get; set; }
            public bool ResetCalled { get; private set; }

            public TestTsavoriteKV(ILogger logger)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
            }

            protected override void Reset()
            {
                ResetCalled = true;
            }

            // Expose InternalRecoverAsync for testing
            public async Task<long> CallInternalRecoverAsync(
                IndexCheckpointInfo recoveredICInfo,
                HybridLogCheckpointInfo recoveredHLCInfo,
                int numPagesToPreload,
                bool undoNextVersion,
                long recoverTo,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken)
            {
                return await InternalRecoverAsync(recoveredICInfo, recoveredHLCInfo, numPagesToPreload, undoNextVersion, recoverTo, cancellationToken);
            }

            // Override dependencies to allow test to run without full implementation
            protected override long GetTailAddress() => 1000;
            protected override long GetFirstValidLogicalAddress(int _) => 0;
            protected override bool RecoverToInitialPage(IndexCheckpointInfo _, HybridLogCheckpointInfo _, out long recoverFromAddress)
            {
                recoverFromAddress = 0;
                return true;
            }
            protected override bool SetRecoveryPageRanges(HybridLogCheckpointInfo _, int __, long ___, out long tailAddress, out long headAddress, out long scanFromAddress)
            {
                tailAddress = 1000;
                headAddress = 0;
                scanFromAddress = 0;
                return true;
            }
            protected override Task<long> RecoverHybridLogAsync(long a, long b, long c, long d, CheckpointType e, RecoveryOptions f, CancellationToken g)
            {
                return Task.FromResult(0L);
            }
            protected override Task<long> RecoverHybridLogFromSnapshotFileAsync(long a, long b, long c, long d, long e, long f, Guid g, RecoveryOptions h, object i, long j, CancellationToken k)
            {
                return Task.FromResult(-1L);
            }
            protected override Task RecoverFuzzyIndexAsync(IndexCheckpointInfo _, CancellationToken __) => Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task InternalRecoverAsync_LogsInformationAndResets_WhenTailAddressGreaterThanFirstValidLogicalAddress()
        {
            var logger = new TestLogger();
            var kv = new TestTsavoriteKV(logger);

            var recoveredICInfo = default(IndexCheckpointInfo);
            var recoveredHLCInfo = new HybridLogCheckpointInfo();
            int numPagesToPreload = 0;
            bool undoNextVersion = false;
            long recoverTo = 0;
            var cancellationToken = CancellationToken.None;

            // Act
            await kv.CallInternalRecoverAsync(recoveredICInfo, recoveredHLCInfo, numPagesToPreload, undoNextVersion, recoverTo, cancellationToken);

            // Assert
            Assert.Contains("Recovery called on non-empty log - resetting to empty state first", logger.LoggedMessages);
            Assert.True(kv.ResetCalled);
        }

        private class TestLogger : ILogger
        {
            public string LoggedMessages { get; private set; } = "";

            public IDisposable BeginScope<TState>(TState state) => null;

            public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;

            public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception exception, Func<TState, Exception, string> formatter)
            {
                if (logLevel == LogLevel.Information)
                {
                    LoggedMessages += formatter(state, exception);
                }
            }
        }

        // Dummy types to satisfy generic constraints
        private class DummyStoreFunctions : IStoreFunctions<int, int> { }
        private class DummyAllocator : IAllocator<int, int, DummyStoreFunctions> { }
    }
}
